title: When Weak Submodularity Meets Matroids: How Does Standard Greedy Behave?
abstract: arXiv:2610.26967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weakly submodular maximization finds numerous applications in machine learning, data mining and statistics. In particular, under a cardinality constraint, the standard greedy algorithm is known to attain the tight $(1-e^{-\gamma})$-approximation guarantee, where $\gamma$ denotes the submodularity ratio. However, when considering general matroid constraints, \emph{how well standard greedy can perform} has remained a longstanding open question. In this paper, we resolve this question by studying the worst-case approximation guarantee $R_{\mathrm{gr}}(\gamma,r)$ of standard forward greedy, where $r$ is the rank of matroid. Specifically, our first contribution is the following refined lower bound \begin{equation*} R_{\gr}(\gamma,r)\ge \max\left\{ \frac{\gamma}{r}, \frac{\gamma^2} {B_\gamma+\sqrt{\gamma(r-1)}}, \frac{\gamma^{r+1}} {2-\gamma+\gamma^{r+1}}, \frac{\gamma^2} {14\left(B_\gamma+\sqrt{\gamma(1-\gamma)(r-1)}\right)} \right\}, \end{

translated_title: 当弱次模性遇上拟阵：标准贪心算法表现如何？
translated_abstract: 弱次模最大化在机器学习、数据挖掘和统计学中有众多应用。特别是在基数约束下，标准贪心算法已被证明可以达到紧致的 $(1-e^{-\gamma})$-近似保证，其中 $\gamma$ 表示次模比。然而，在考虑一般拟阵约束时，标准贪心算法究竟能表现多好一直是一个长期悬而未决的开放问题。本文通过研究标准前向贪心算法的最坏情况近似保证 $R_{\mathrm{gr}}(\gamma,r)$（其中 $r$ 为拟阵的秩）来解答这一问题。具体而言，本文的第一个贡献是给出了如下精化的下界：$R_{\gr}(\gamma,r)\ge \max\left\{ \frac{\gamma}{r}, \frac{\gamma^2}{B_\gamma+\sqrt{\gamma(r-1)}}, \frac{\gamma^{r+1}}{2-\gamma+\gamma^{r+1}}, \frac{\gamma^2}{14\left(B_\gamma+\sqrt{\gamma(1-\gamma)(r-1)}\right)} \right\}$。
tldr: 本文解决了弱次模最大化在一般拟阵约束下标准贪心算法最坏情况近似保证这一长期开放问题，给出了以次模比 $\gamma$ 和拟阵秩 $r$ 表达的精化下界。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves the longstanding open question of the worst-case approximation guarantee of the standard greedy algorithm for weakly submodular maximization under general matroid constraints, establishing refined lower bounds in terms of the submodularity ratio $\gamma$ and the matroid rank $r$.
